# Positive cases. Each block starts with "=== " and the comma-separated rules
# that must be found (exactly that set). "{{name}}" is replaced at test time by
# a generated value of that format, so no real-looking token is stored here.
# "@secret " lines name literal text that must be gone after Redact.

=== github-token
export GITHUB_TOKEN={{ghp}}

=== github-token
{"oauth": {"access": "{{gho}}", "scope": "repo"}}

=== github-token
git clone https://x-access-token:{{ghs}}@github.com/example/repo.git

=== github-token
here is the fine-grained one {{github_pat}} it expires next month

=== github-token
user token {{ghu}} and refresh token below

=== github-token
GH_REFRESH={{ghr}}

=== anthropic-api-key

=== openai-api-key
